rationale: The agent performed write actions (modify_pending_order_items and modify_pending_order_address) without visible prior user confirmation, violating the confirm-before-write policy. There is no clear authentication step shown (e.g., find_user_id_by_name_zip/get_user_details) before acting, nor confirmation that the order belonged to the user. The agent used a gift card payment method for the modification, then later stated it was unable to change the payment method, and did not adapt to the user’s fallback to PayPal and limiting the change to only the backpack as stipulated. Final confirmation or accurate summary of completed changes is missing. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
